notes.subject: לפתע פתאם
notes.rationale: Pitpit bilong tupela tok wanpela rot (peta‘-), 'long moment — stat stret', singaut i strong long Tok Pisin tu

notes.subject: זריך
notes.rationale: Zipor: 'ol man bilong narapela ples i save skaterim yu' o 'ol birua bilong yu' (KJV 'strangers', JPS 'foes')

notes.subject: עריצים
notes.rationale: 'ol man bilong strong nogut we ol i save traim narapela' — Strong's 'fearful, tyrannical', 'terrible ones' long ol Baibel i singautim role tasol

translation: Na bai i kamap olsem das smol, ⟨olgeta⟩ man i save skaterim yu; na olsem mit bilong gaden i wokabaut i go, ⟨olgeta⟩ man bilong strong nogut we ol i save traim narapela; na bai i kamap long moment smol — stat stret, narataim nogat.
